capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Audi US 2024 release: "82-kilowatt-hour battery (77 kWh of net capacity)". Wikipedia: Q4 40/45/50 82 gross for 2021-mid 2024; the 2025 Q4 45 uses the same pack (Cars.com).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Audi US 2024 release states 77 kWh net for the 82 kWh pack; Wikipedia gives 82/77 for 2021-mid 2024 Q4 40/45/50; years 2022-2024 compared, pack unchanged.

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: "Nickel-Manganese-Cobalt (NMC) battery cells" (LG Energy Solution, CATL).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: the Q4 e-tron uses the MEB platform and its 82 kWh pack; Guide Auto lists the same-platform VW ID.4 82 kWh pack at 400 V. No Audi page states the Q4 voltage.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: platform sibling (MEB): InsideEVs says ID.4/ID.5 built 2020-2024 had no battery preconditioning. The Audi US 2024 Q4 55 release introduces route-planner preconditioning with the update, and nothing shows it on the pre-update Q4 (2022-2023, 2024 Q4 40/45/50). Weak: no Audi page states that earlier Q4s lacked it.

dc_max_kw.notes: Audi US 2024 release: new Q4 55 accepts up to 175 kW "instead of 150 kW previously" (Q4 50, 2022-2024 pre-update). Wikipedia lists 135 kW for the 2021 European 40/45/50.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Audi US 2024 update lists an 11 kW onboard charger; Wikipedia lists 11 kW for Q4 40 and up since 2021. Years compared 2022-2024.
